findings.detail: Direct-lending rows with visible Reference Rate and Spread values in the SOI were extracted with blank interest_rate, including AB Centers and Any Hour DDTL/revolver rows.

rationale: The rule flags low direct-lending interest-rate fill (metric 78.1; 28 violations). The raw SOI has a Reference Rate and Spread column, and cited direct-lending rows show explicit terms such as S + 5.25 % and S + 5.00 %. The bundle's holdings slice shows the same issuers/instruments with blank interest_rate, so the flag is a real extraction gap rather than a false alarm. No aggregate fair-value anchor is needed for this rate-completeness issue.
